page.overview:
Who is Corporal Josh Coolant?

Corporal Josh Coolant is a minor supporting character in Cars 2.

In Cars 2, Sarge asks the British Army to help him find Mater. They later appear at the end to arrest the lemons, when Josh reveals his grandfather to be one of Sarge's friends.
